subject: Change axis labels for particular facets?

messages.author: cb79f27287ee7406
messages.subject: Change axis labels for particular facets?
parts:
I think I've exhausted google on this one and don't think it can be
done, but wanted to check here as a last resort. I have a plot that
is faceted into a 3x3 grid. The axis labels are repeated on all three
bottom facets, but I only want them on the bottom middle one. Is
there a way to specify this? Thank you.

messages.author: daf017f67eba24e8
messages.subject: Re: Change axis labels for particular facets?
parts:
Hi Kallie-

Some would probably argue that you should probably reveal what it is you are grouping/faceting against using those labels. 

ignoring those high-minded ideals, it sounds like you have a factor variable with levels 1,2,3 which all have the same label. you could try setting the labels for 1 and 3 to the null string or a space using var<-factor(var,labels=c(" ","the.label"," ")) then replotting. or you could label them appropriately.

as always, a reproducible example is the best way to communicate. if you make one up, i'll show you how to do it.

James
